_rootGeometryMarker: ROOT GEOMETRY — the same shrink-only ratchet for the root-geometry table (REPORT.md 'Root geometry'). Key: '<cohort>/<variant>#<fact kind>'. Every row is a measured MISMATCH between the React root's measured box fact and the native main's readback value, with its cause. Closed class set, each admitting only its own fact kinds: declared-dimension-differs (width, height), padding-differs, border-width-differs, radius-differs, paint-differs (background, border-paint), opacity-differs, gap-differs, shadow-differs. Nothing here changes a verdict; the check is red on a mismatch not listed, on a listed row that no longer mismatches, on a listed row the table does not measure, on an unknown class and on a class that does not fit the fact kind. A `not-comparable` fact is never listed here: its reason is printed in the report and its count is pinned in the check.
